Delhi CM Urges Citizens to Join 'Nikshay Mitra' Initiative for TB Eradication

Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta has called upon citizens to become 'Nikshay Mitras' to aid in the eradication of Tuberculosis (TB) in the city. The initiative aims to leverage community participation to achieve the goal of making Delhi TB-free. Delhi has reportedly achieved 95% of its TB notification target, according to reports. The CM's appeal encourages individuals to contribute to the public health effort.
